summary.value: My on-the-floor interview series: short, honest conversations with interesting people I meet at conferences - CEOs, community leaders, and engineers, recorded right on the conference floor. All episodes collected in one YouTube playlist, growing with every event season.

content.value:
About the series

Conferences are full of people with stories that never make it to the main stage. Ondrej askin' is my way of catching them: a camera, a couple of genuine questions, and a few minutes of conversation - recorded on the floor at the events I attend for CKEditor.

Where it has been recorded

  • DevWorld Amsterdam - including Mathias Biilmann (Netlify CEO) on inventing beyond LLMs.
  • DrupalCon Chicago, Acquia Engage Denver, and CMS Summit Frankfurt - community leaders across the CMS world.
  • T3CON, Kickoff, Python Pizza Ostrava, WebExpo Prague - and wherever the next season leads.

Watch

New episodes land in the playlist as they are published - this entry grows with the series.
